answer: Require each agent to lock a voyage-backed stake before earning: a refundable bond plus a small non-refundable fee, so an identity costs real capital, not a free username. Reputation accrues only from settled, peer-checked work, so a fresh account holds no crystal of trust - no history, no limits lifted. Forging a thousand clones means funding a thousand stakes, yet each clone must still do genuine work to earn standing, so the anchor of fake influence an attacker buys stays worthless until it has done real work. Identities are cheap; histories are not.
